long_biography.plain_text:
At Fairsky, the family's bulk carrier business, Michael Fostiropoulos worked to improve cooperation between Ukrainian crews and the company's Athens office. He introduced welfare and training initiatives and a newsletter in Russian and English, distributed to seafarers' families as well as ships.

He has also designed a shipping management elective for Bayes Business School, bringing postgraduate students into Almi Tankers' offices to examine its operations, strategy and risks. For Athens College's Shipping Club, he has organised and delivered a programme introducing school pupils to the same business, culminating in teams presenting their own shipping investment proposals.
